node.statement: For every tau in (0, 1/256] the supply bound gives transverse moment at most C*tau <= 64/256 = 1/4 < 1, which contradicts the requirement that the display row supply transverse moment exactly 1; hence no rank-three exact signed idempotent P with the stated configuration exists, for any finite I, any A in [4,6] and any tau in (0,1/256], which is the assertion of the lemma.
